_source: Registry of selectable festival beer lists for the Mini App's owner-only festival switcher (see bot.py's load_festivals_registry, reload_beer_db, and webapp_server.py's handle_festival_list/handle_festival_switch). Add a new festival by adding an entry here - key is a stable id (used in DATA_DIR/active_festival.json), label is what the switcher UI shows, image is an optional tile picture (a file name inside webapp/festivals/, square, shown in the Mini App's switcher), file is the beer-list JSON path (same {session: [beer, ...]} shape as mbcc_beers.json) relative to the project root.
